hypothesis: Previous cards tested one signal family at a time. Run a single, consistent, causal search across every locally available SOXL data source and ask the one question that matters: does any past-only signal produce a STABLE excess over SOXX buy-and-hold defined as beating return AND drawdown AND Sharpe simultaneously with a majority of positive calendar years.
parameter_search_budget: one pre-registered family; thresholds are expanding-window quantiles, not fitted
sources: data/raw/external futu capital flow / distribution (SOXL/SOXX order-flow proxy)
exposure_rule: hold SOXL when the expanding-window signal quantile is satisfied, else SOXX; 10/25bp turnover cost

gates.stable_excess: beats SOXX return AND drawdown AND Sharpe on the window with at least minimum_positive_years positive calendar years
gates.promotion: development stable excess, confirmed on reused diagnostic and any forward window

stopping: Exactly the pre-registered family at two costs across three windows; no signal, threshold, window or cost tuning after outcomes. Preserve all results, including failures.
limitations: A broad search can overfit; a hit must survive an independent forward window.
Constituent history ends 2026-07-02, so leader signals do not cover the forward window.
No return forecast or fitted parameter is used.
SOXL realized leverage decay is only reflected in its traded prices.
